sourceOriginality.method: Exact whole-text equality after punctuation/apostrophe/case normalisation; source sentences of at least five words.
sourceOriginality.limitations: Does not detect every copied subsection or prove original wording, contextual diversity, rights clearance or semantic quality.

nearDuplicates.method: Rare English four-word and Chinese three-character shingles; Sorensen-Dice similarity; generic task instructions excluded.
nearDuplicates.limitations: Lexical screening only. No flag is not semantic approval; each lesson has separate editorial review.

flags.rationale: The prompts share an editing-question scaffold. The far-beyond lesson asks for an omitted comparison boundary; the bring-it-back lesson asks for a recoverable pronoun referent in a restoration context. The required complements and evidence differ. This is a targeted comparison, not certification of all unflagged pairs.

sensitivityComparison.scope: Actual flagged prompts, options, explanations, meanings and source contexts individually compared.

approvalScope: Provenance reconciliation and lexical-screening proposal only. No human approval, audio-hearing approval, browser approval, deployment or database state is certified.
